entities.name: Gull
entities.description: A human woodcutter from North Aerona on Dominaria who became an experienced fighter against evil wizards and leader of an army.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Gull's planeswalker sister, a druid wizard who could not talk at first and later became High Wizard of the Domains.

entities.name: Sparrow Hawk
entities.description: Gull's younger brother, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser into a Keldon warlord.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Evil wizard who hired Gull as freightmaster and killed his family.

entities.name: Lily
entities.description: A dancing girl and secret wizard whom Gull loves and marries.

entities.name: Morven
entities.description: Old sailor turned bodyguard and Gull's friend.

entities.name: Stiggur
entities.description: The cook's boy who befriends Gull.

entities.name: Kem
entities.description: Bodyguard who antagonizes Gull until Gull saves him.

entities.name: Helki
entities.description: Centaur summoned and mind-controlled by wizards.

entities.name: Holleb
entities.description: Centaur summoned and mind-controlled by wizards.

entities.name: Liko
entities.description: Two-Headed Giant stranded after the battle.

entities.name: Rakel
entities.description: Assassin sent against Gull who fell in love with him and became a commander.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Wizard defeated by the army who later fireballs the brothers.

entities.name: Kwam
entities.description: Greensleeves's lover who brings her to her senses.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: Gull's village on the border of the Whispering Woods, destroyed in a wizards' duel.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Isle where the Stone Brain lies and where the final battle occurs.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: The artifact Towser believed to be a mana vault.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The final battle in which Greensleeves poured her power into the isle.

events.summary: White Ridge is destroyed in a wizards' duel, killing Gull's parents and two siblings.
events.quote: many of the villagers were killed, including Gull's parents and two of his siblings

events.summary: Towser asks Gull to become his freightmaster and Gull, confused by mind magic, accepts and brings Greensleeves.
events.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepted his offer

events.summary: The convoy reaches a coastal city where Greensleeves suddenly speaks, her thoughts cleared of the Woods' magic.
Towser reveals he will kill Greensleeves to store her power in the mana vault and teleports Gull, Morven and Stiggur to an island.
events.quote: Towser was forced to teleport Gull away

events.summary: Summoned back by Lily, Gull fights Towser; Kem changes sides and Greensleeves casts an earthquake and tsunami, sweeping away Morven, Kem and most of Towser's entourage.
events.quote: Gull and his friends vowed to form an army to fight Towser

events.summary: Gull and Greensleeves build an army; Rakel joins as commander, the army defeats Haakon, and Gull rescues Rakel and her son from Benalia.
events.quote: Gull rescued Rakel and her son, Hammen, from Benalia

events.summary: Greensleeves teleports the survivors to safety as Towser's wizards and a Keldon warlord attack from three directions.
events.quote: Greensleeves teleported herself, Gull, and the survivors of their army to their headquarters

events.summary: At Lat-Nam Gull realizes the warlord is his lost brother Sparrow Hawk and the brothers reconcile.
Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers; Greensleeves goes mad, becomes godlike, but is calmed by Kwam and pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing it and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
Greensleeves is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
events.quote: Greensleeves was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

relations.quote: Traveling with his planeswalker sister Greensleeves

relations.note: He fell in love with her and married her.
relations.quote: He also fell in love with Lily

relations.note: Towser killed his family and he vowed to fight him.
relations.quote: Towser, who Gull now realized was the wizard who had killed his family

relations.note: Sent to assassinate him, they fell in love.
relations.quote: the two instead fell in love

relations.note: Kidnapped and enchanted him into a war machine.
relations.quote: kidnapped and enchanted by Towser to be a war machine
